Worker.title: Worker Profile
Worker.description: The digital profile of a skilled worker, including their photo, skill types, daily rate, and real-time availability.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the worker.

phone.description: Contact phone number of the worker.

skills.description: List of skill tags matched from pre-defined chips.

dailyRate.description: Standard daily work rate in Indian Rupees (INR).

locationName.description: Neighborhood or village name of the worker.

photo.description: Profile picture (image URLs or base64 representation).

imageUrls.description: Image URLs of past work samples displayed in worker profile grid.

gallery.description: Up to 3 photos of recent works (image URLs or base64).

isAvailable.description: Toggle indicating if the worker is available for work today.

unavailableDates.description: List of upcoming dates (YYYY-MM-DD) marked as unavailable by the worker.

skillProficiencies.description: Self-assessed proficiency scores (0-100) across listed skills.

experience.description: Years of experience in the skilled labor.

about.description: Short bio or statement of pride/experience.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

Review.title: Worker Review
Review.description: Review or rating submitted by a customer for verified past work.

workerId.description: UID of the worker who received the review.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who posted the review.

authorName.description: Name of the customer providing review.

comment.description: Detailed comment about the work quality.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the review was written.

Inquiry.title: Customer Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Work or booking inquiry submitted by a customer to a worker.

workerId.description: UID of the worker receiving the inquiry.

customerName.description: Name or contact of the customer inquiring.

customerPhone.description: Phone number or WhatsApp contact of the customer.

message.description: Details of the inquiry, work required, or date requested.

read.description: Whether the worker has viewed or read the inquiry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.

User.title: User Account
User.description: User profile with their phone number, email, selected role (customer or worker), and account metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number with country code (e.g. +91XXXXXXXXXX) if linked or provided.

email.description: Email address of the user if signed up with email or linked.

displayName.description: Full display name of the user from Google profile or manual registration.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google Sign-In or profile picture.

role.description: Active role of the user: 'customer' (hiring) or 'worker' (looking for work).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account or role was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of user accounts storing role and phone authentication data.

/workers/{workerId}.description: Collection of skilled worker digital identities.

/workers/{workerId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Customer reviews for a specific worker.

/workers/{workerId}/inquiries/{inquiryId.description: Incoming inquiries and messages sent to this worker by local customers.
